title: Customer churn triage
goal: Show a customer-success decision tree that routes renewal and health risks to actions.

rubric.must: The root visibly asks whether renewal is within 90 days.
The near-renewal, declining-usage path visibly checks executive-sponsor engagement before recovery or executive outreach.
The not-near-renewal, low-health path visibly checks for an unresolved critical issue.
Visible leaves include sponsor recovery, executive outreach, value confirmation, incident leadership, and proactive review actions.
Each decision visibly uses readable Yes and No branches.

ideal.notes: Redrawn from the source with the independent taxonomy exemplar drawing script; no engine geometry or screenshot used to build the target.

review.evidence: Visually reviewed against the taxonomy exemplar and source: complete questions and outcomes, numbered hexagons, unambiguous Yes/No drops, and a shared outcome row. No clipped labels or material collisions. Unclassified outcomes remain neutral.
